answer: Measure the delta, not the headcount: each identity gets two invitation slots per epoch, and a recruit that fails an audit burns the parent's remaining slots. Quorums must span unrelated subnetworks, so an operator cannot stack a panel with accounts carved from the same timber. A farm's branching factor stays at 2 while its cost per surviving branch doubles each generation, so growth flattens on a mesa long before the zenith of a thousand identities.
